sources.label: rmsbroadcast
sources.method: Tiered content census on the admitted GPU host: every key listed (resumable inventory on the host volume); every audio file and a per-folder sample of video files header-probed (ranged reads, ffprobe) for duration, codec and rate; a deterministic stratified sample of files per folder — or every file under content_full — read byte for byte, verified against the listing, decoded in full and judged on every two-second window by the admitted music detector and the current audio language model on every GPU of the host; ratio estimators with finite-population correction give 95 % intervals; per-object rows stay on the host; aggregates only in this receipt. Objects the key cannot read are counted, never estimated.
